import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans

# Read input
df = pd.read_csv("outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv")

# Identify numeric indicator columns (exclude identifier columns)
id_cols = ["city_id", "city_name", "year"]
indicator_cols = [c for c in df.columns if c not in id_cols]

# Extract raw data for cluster profiles (before imputation)
raw_data = df[indicator_cols].copy()

# Extract feature matrix
X_raw = df[indicator_cols].values.astype(float)

# Median imputation
imputer = SimpleImputer(strategy="median")
X_imputed = imputer.fit_transform(X_raw)

# Standard scaling
scaler = StandardScaler()
X_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X_imputed)

# KMeans clustering
kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=3, random_state=0, n_init=10)
cluster_labels = kmeans.fit_predict(X_scaled)

# Write t13_city_clusters.csv
clusters_df = pd.DataFrame({
    "city_id": df["city_id"],
    "city_name": df["city_name"],
    "year": df["year"],
    "cluster_id": cluster_labels
})
clusters_df.to_csv("outputs/t13_city_clusters.csv", index=False, quoting=1)

# Compute cluster profiles: mean of raw indicator values (non-missing) per cluster
profiles = []
for cluster_id in sorted(set(cluster_labels)):
    mask = cluster_labels == cluster_id
    row = {"cluster_id": cluster_id}
    for col in indicator_cols:
        vals = raw_data.loc[mask, col]
        non_missing = vals.dropna()
        row[col] = non_missing.mean() if len(non_missing) > 0 else np.nan
    profiles.append(row)

profiles_df = pd.DataFrame(profiles)
profiles_df.to_csv("outputs/t13_cluster_profiles.csv", index=False, quoting=1)

print("Done. Output files created.")
print(f"t13_city_clusters.csv: {len(clusters_df)} rows")
print(f"t13_cluster_profiles.csv: {len(profiles_df)} rows")
</solution_file>
